title: Covering design C(37,8,2,3)
statement: Find 8-subsets (blocks) of {1, ..., 37} such that every 3-subset meets some block in at least 2 points, with as few blocks as possible. The best known size in the Covering Repository is 15 blocks (ours); a design with fewer blocks improves it.
submission: Text file: one block per line, 8 distinct points from 1..37 separated by spaces.

best_known.source: Covering Repository (coveringrepository.com), C(37,8,2,3) = 15 blocks: ours, listed since 2026-10-26 (before it 16); read 6 Nov 2026

provenance.revision: repository read on the date given

score: the number of blocks (smaller is better)
quantavane_note: our object is the best known entry of the source table
